About the play partner: Orange County Buddhist Church (OCBC) 
The Orange County Buddhist Church (OCBC) is a Jōdo Shinshū (Shin Buddhist) temple located in Anaheim, California, and a member of the Buddhist Churches of America’s (BCA) Southern District. Originally established to serve the Japanese American community, OCBC has grown into a vibrant center of Shin Buddhist life in Southern California. The church achieved independent status in 1965 and has been serving the greater Orange County region for over six decades. 
OCBC is affiliated with the Jōdo Shinshū Hongwanji-ha tradition, whose head temple (Nishi Honganji) is located in Kyoto, Japan.

Included in museum admission. Space is limited! Book your tickets now. 
*Members do not require a reservation.

About the play partner: 
Environmental Nature Center’s mission is to provide transformative experiences through connection with nature. 
Frequently Asked Questions 
Is this program included with museum admission?
Yes. Habitat Hike Animal Encounter is included with regular museum admission. 
What animals will families meet?
Families may meet 3–4 live animals from desert and forest habitats. Animals may vary by program. 
What are biofacts?
Biofacts are natural items that come from animals, such as feathers, fur, bones, or shells, that help children learn more about wildlife. 
How long does the program last?
Each presentation lasts approximately 10–30 minutes.

events.title: Artists in Action with Chuck Jones
events.display_title: Artists in Action with Chuck Jones
events.description:
Artists in Action with Chuck Jones Center for Creativity invites families to explore creativity together through hands-on experiences led by real artists. Each visit offers new materials, fresh ideas, and playful ways for children to express themselves and connect through art.
Times: 11am-12pm 
About the play partner: 
Founded upon the time-honored philosophies of legendary, Oscar-winning animation director Chuck Jones, the Chuck Jones Center for Creativity is a 501c3 charity dedicated to stimulating innovative thinking, individual expression and interpersonal collaboration – on its mission to nurture creative solutions to some of society’s most urgent and unmet needs. Our programs for youth (including those on the autism spectrum), adults of all ages, schools, businesses and organizational teams focus on elevating, celebrating and accelerating the creative genius in all of us, all for the betterment of the individuals, the groups and the communities we serve.
Frequently Asked Questions 
Is this program included with museum admission?
Yes. Artists in Action is included with regular museum admission. 
What ages is this program best for?
This experience is designed for children ages 0–8 and their families. 
Is this a structured class?
No. This is a drop-in, open-ended creative experience where families can participate at their own pace. 
When should we arrive?
Families can drop in anytime between 11:00 am and 1:45 pm. 
Will materials be provided?
Yes. All materials are provided as part of the experience. 
Who is Chuck Jones?
Chuck Jones was a legendary, Oscar-winning animation director best known for creating and directing beloved characters like Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, and the Road Runner. His legacy continues through the Chuck Jones Center for Creativity, which inspires people of all ages to explore creativity and innovation. 
*Please note programming lasts 10-30 minutes.

events.title: Food as Medicine with Rady Children’s Health
events.display_title: Food as Medicine with Rady Children’s Health
events.description:
Join us for Food as Medicine, a hands-on experience where kids and their grown-ups explore seasonal, nourishing foods together with Rady Children’s Health.   
Times: 11am-12pm  
*Please note programming lasts 10-30 minutes. 
About the Play Partner:
Rady Children’s Health (RCH), a premier pediatric healthcare system in Southern California, unites the trusted expertise of Children’s Hospital of Orange County (CHOC), nationally recognized for its commitment to safe, high-quality care, and Rady Children’s Hospital San Diego, ranked among the nation’s top 10 children’s hospitals by U.S. News & World Report. @chocchildrens 
Included in museum admission. Space is limited! Book your tickets now. 
*Members do not require a reservation.
*Events and dates are subject to change. 
Frequently Asked Questions 
Is this program included with museum admission?
Yes. Food as Medicine is included with regular museum admission. 
Will there be food samples?
Yes. Families will have the opportunity to sample seasonal foods during the program. 
What kinds of activities will children explore?
Children may participate in sensory stations, food demonstrations, and hands-on activities focused on healthy eating and nutrition. 
Will recipes be available?
Yes. Families may receive recipes and ideas for easy, nutritious meals and snacks they can make at home.

events.title: Wild About Animals with Doodlebugs Animal Adventures
events.display_title: Wild About Animals with Doodlebugs Animal Adventures
events.description:
Get ready for a wild adventure! Join Doodlebugs Animal Adventures for an exciting live animal presentation featuring creatures from around the world.  
Time: 11am-12pm
*Please note programming lasts 10-30 minutes. 
Space is limited! Book your tickets now; this program is included in museum admission.
Disclaimer: *Events and dates are subject to change.

About the play partner:
Doodlebugs Animal Adventures offers educational LIVE animal presentations and story-times throughout Orange County and surrounding cities. With our hands-on approach to learning we encourage each child’s innate sense of wonder about the world around them. With the help of our LIVE animal friends, participants build empathy and a sense of connection with all living things. At Doodlebugs Animal Adventures we believe a curious mind can change the world. 
Frequently Asked Questions

How long is the program?
The live presentation lasts approximately 20 minutes, followed by opportunities to meet some of the animals.

Will children be able to touch the animals?
Guests will have the opportunity to touch certain animals following the presentation.

What animals will be featured?
Animal appearances may vary, but may include birds, reptiles, amphibians, insects, and mammals.

Is this program included with admission?
Yes! This program is included with museum admission.

Do I need to reserve a spot?
Space is limited. We recommend booking your tickets in advance.

events.title: Hunger Action Month Kickoff
events.description:
Join us for a hands-on community service experience with Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County. Children and families will work together to sort and pack fresh produce that will help support neighbors facing food insecurity throughout our community. 
Time: 9am-12pm
Included in museum admission. Space is limited! Book your tickets now.

*Members do not require a reservation.
*Events and dates are subject to change. 
About the play partner:
Second Harvest Food Bank is a nonprofit organization in Orange County.
Their Vision: Orange County with food and nutritional security for all.
Their Mission: In collaboration with our partners, we provide dignified, equitable and consistent access to nutritious food, creating a foundation for community health.
Their Value: Integrity, accountability, people first, compassion, purpose driven, stewardship 
Frequently Asked Questions

Who can participate?
Children and families of all ages are welcome to help pack produce alongside the Second Harvest Food Bank team.

Do I need any special experience?
No experience is needed. Second Harvest staff and volunteers will provide instructions and guidance throughout the activity.

What will we be doing?
Families will help sort and pack fresh produce that will be distributed to local children, families, and seniors experiencing food insecurity

Why is Pretend City hosting this event?
As part of Hunger Action Month, we’re helping children learn that they can make a positive impact in their community through acts of kindness and service

How does this support child development?
Children practice counting, sorting, teamwork, problem-solving, and fine motor skills while learning empathy, generosity, and community responsibility

Is there an additional cost to participate?
No. This activity is included with museum admission

Can my child participate for only part of the event?
Yes. Families are welcome to stop by anytime between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM

Where does the food go?
The packed produce will be distributed through Second Harvest Food Bank’s network of community partners serving families throughout Orange County

How many families can participate?
Participation is available on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
